mapper.insert: INSERT INTO wrong_question ( student_id, question_id, exam_id, course_id, wrong_answer, correct_answer, note, wrong_count, correct_count, is_mastered, first_wrong_time, last_wrong_time, mastered_time, create_time, update_time ) VALUES ( #{studentId}, #{questionId}, #{examId}, #{courseId}, #{wrongAnswer}, #{correctAnswer}, #{note}, #{wrongCount}, #{correctCount}, #{isMastered}, #{firstWrongTime}, #{lastWrongTime}, #{masteredTime}, #{createTime}, #{updateTime} )
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM wrong_question WHERE student_id = #{studentId} AND question_id = #{questionId}
mapper.update: UPDATE wrong_question SET wrong_count = wrong_count + 1, last_wrong_time = NOW(), update_time = NOW(), is_mastered = 0, mastered_time = NULL WHERE id = #{id}
UPDATE wrong_question SET correct_count = correct_count + 1, update_time = NOW() WHERE id = #{id}
UPDATE wrong_question SET correct_count = 0, update_time = NOW() WHERE id = #{id}
UPDATE wrong_question SET is_mastered = 1, mastered_time = NOW(), update_time = NOW() WHERE id = #{id}
UPDATE wrong_question SET is_mastered = 0, mastered_time = NULL, update_time = NOW() WHERE id = #{id}
UPDATE wrong_question SET note = #{note}, update_time = NOW() WHERE id = #{id}
